description: One short NPC utterance plus an auditable declaration of the approved information it expresses or references.

utterance.description: Player-visible in-character dialogue without IDs, stage directions, or metadata.

expressed_disclosure_ids.description: Ordered IDs of application-approved disclosure records expressed in the utterance; each record fixes claim, stance, and provenance.

referenced_episode_ids.description: Approved NPC episodes materially used in the utterance.

referenced_entity_ids.description: Every canonical character, location, item, or motive named in the utterance.

referenced_actor_ids.description: Every approved player or NPC actor explicitly named as a speaker, listener, or source in the utterance.
